items.title: Portemilio Hotel & Resort
items.description: Relaxed rooms & suites in a seaside resort offering 2 outdoor pools, a sundeck & tennis courts.
items.hotelDescription:
This seafront resort is 4 km from the rides and attractions of Dream Park, 6 km from the high-end Casino du Liban, and 11 km from Our Lady of Lebanon's Christian church and pilgrimage site.
 The relaxed rooms and suites come with free Wi-Fi, minibars, and safes, as well as flat-screen TVs with cable channels. Some rooms have balconies offering views of the city or the sea. Upgraded rooms and suites feature living areas, and a few add kitchenettes and dining tables.
 The hotel has an outdoor lagoon-style pool and a separate lap pool, plus a sundeck and tennis courts.

items.description: Straightforward rooms in a casual hotel offering an outdoor pool, a restaurant & a business center.
items.address: New Mina Street, Opposite to Municipality, Next to Middle East Airlines "MEA", Jounieh, Lebanon
items.street: New Mina Street, Opposite to Municipality, Next to Middle East Airlines "MEA"
items.hotelDescription:
Set along the Mediterranean coast, this relaxed hotel is 2 km from aerial views at Téléphérique and 7 km from Casino du Liban. Highway 51 is 1 km away.
 The straightforward rooms feature minifridges, flat-screen TVs and free Wi-Fi, in addition to balconies. Room service is available.
 There’s parking, a meeting room and an outdoor pool. Other amenities include a restaurant, a bar and a business center.

items.title: Bay Lodge Boutique Hotel
items.subTitle: فندق باي لودج البوتيكي
items.description: Polished hotel offering a bar/restaurant with a terrace overlooking the sea, plus a cocktail bar.
items.address: Harissa Highway, Jounieh, Jounieh, Mount Lebanon, Lebanon, Lebanon
items.hotelDescription:
Set on a hill and surrounded by woodland, this upscale hotel offers views of the Mediterranean Sea. It's 5 km from the Lebanese Heritage Museum and 8 km from Casino du Liban.
 Casual wood-paneled rooms include free Wi-Fi, minibars, safes and flat-screen TVs. Suites add sitting areas, and whirlpool tubs with sea views. An upgraded suite provides a dining and separate sitting area.
 There's a top floor cocktail bar offering panoramic views, plus a casual restaurant featuring a terrace overlooking the sea. Other amenities include an outdoor pool with a hot tub and a sundeck, and a bistro.

items.title: JOUNIEH SUITES BOUTIQUE HOTEL
items.description: Relaxed quarters in a refined hotel offering a hip bar/restaurant & a rooftop pool with sea views.
items.hotelDescription:
In a commercial area 10 minutes' walk from the Mediterranean Sea shoreline, this polished hotel is 4 km from the Téléphérique cable car to the Our Lady of Lebanon shrine. It's less than 1 km from the coastal highway.
 The warm, relaxed rooms offer free Wi-Fi, flat-screens and minifridges, plus tea and coffeemakers, safes and en suite, shower-only bathrooms. Upgraded rooms add sitting areas, wet bars and microwaves, plus sea views; some have balconies. Some suites include living rooms and/or hot tubs. Room service is available.
 Parking is complimentary. There's a hip restaurant and bar, and a rooftop pool with sea views. Breakfast is offered (fee).

items.title: Lamedina Hotel, Beach & Resort
items.description: Laid-back seaside resort with a private beach, outdoor dining & free breakfast, plus outdoor pools.
items.address: Sea Side Road Facing Téléphérique du Liban Jounieh, Jounieh, Lebanon
items.street: Sea Side Road Facing Téléphérique du Liban Jounieh
items.hotelDescription:
On a beach overlooking the Mediterranean Sea, this relaxed family-run resort is across the street from a gondola to Our Lady of Lebanon, a hilltop monument. It's 3 km from the Casino du Liban and 27 km from Beirut-Rafic Hariri International Airport.
 Basic rooms offer TVs, minifridges and en suite bathrooms. Upgraded rooms have balconies and/or whirlpool tubs, and suites add separate living areas. Wi-Fi is available.
 Parking and a breakfast buffet are free. There's a seasonal outdoor pool, a kids' pool and a playground, plus a private beach. Other amenities include a casual restaurant and a poolside bar.

items.hotelDescription:
Beside a beach on the Mediterranean Sea, this modest hotel is 29 km from Beirut International Airport, and 8 km from the Lebanese Marine and Wildlife Museum.
 Featuring warm or modern decor, the rooms offer Wi-Fi, cable TV and safes, plus fridges, and sea or city views. Suites add living areas. In-room dining is available.
 Breakfast is offered. Other amenities include a private beach, a restaurant/bar and a seasonal outdoor pool, as well as activities like diving and boat trips. An airport shuttle is also available.

items.title: Le Royal Hotel Beirut
items.description: Upscale hotel featuring refined dining, bars & a spa, plus a sprawling water park & sea views.
items.hotelDescription:
On a hillside overlooking the Mediterranean Sea, this luxe, sprawling hotel is 22 km from Beirut Rafic Hariri International Airport.
 Featuring furnished balconies, the warm rooms come with Wi-Fi and flat-screens, plus minibars, and tea and coffeemakers; some add sofas and/or sea views. Upgraded suites provide butler service. There's also a 3-bedroom apartment.
 Amenities consist of 2 restaurants, 2 bars and a nightclub, along with a 20,000 sq m water park. A 6,000 sq m spa offers sea views, an indoor pool and a gym.

 Understated rooms with wood furnishings provide Wi-Fi, minibars and TVs. Upgraded rooms add sitting areas or whirlpool tubs, while suites feature separate living rooms. Room service is available 24/7.

items.title: Princessa Hotel
items.description: Warm rooms & dramatic suites, plus a rooftop deck featuring an infinity pool with a swim-up bar.
items.hotelDescription:
Overlooking a bay in the Mediterranean Sea, this polished hotel is a 4-minute walk from the gondola lifts of Téléphérique and 8 km from the Our Lady of Lebanon shrine.
 Warmly decorated rooms feature tufted headboards and flat-screen TVs, and some add seating areas. Upgraded rooms add illuminated crystal canopies and dining areas. Suites feature upholstered ceilings and jetted whirlpool tubs, and upgraded suites offer separate living rooms and balconies with sea views. Some add kitchenettes or full kitchens.
 Amenities include a rooftop deck with an indoor bar and a striking outdoor infinity pool with a swim-up bar and panoramic sea views.
